entry.title: Mission Beta
entry.summary: A second short mission write-up, cross-linking Mission Alpha to prove zero dangling links survive the rename.
entry.content: Like Mission Alpha, this page lived at plans/features/mission-beta.md before the section was renamed to plans/missions/ (E-08). Both this page’s inline link and its related: frontmatter entry point at the post-rename path — check-links.mjs asserts neither dangles.
